# SpriteAnimator

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SpriteAnimator")`

Plays frames of its parent `Part2D`'s sprite sheet on the simulation clock (ADR 0102), so a walk cycle is data instead of script. Each tick it is playing, it writes the parent's `ImageRectOffset` and `ImageRectSize` for the frame it is on; the picture, the undo and the wire all see that as they see any write.

Frames are counted along the sheet's rows from `SheetOffset`, `Columns` to a row. A non-looped animation that reaches its end stops and writes `Playing = false`, which is its end event: listen with `GetPropertyChangedSignal("Playing")`.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Columns` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How many frames make one row of the sheet. |
| `FirstFrame` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The frame this animation starts on, counted from `SheetOffset`. |
| `Frame` | `number` | — | read-only | The frame it is on, from 0 at `FirstFrame`. |
| `FrameCount` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How many frames it plays. |
| `FrameSize` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.new(16, 16)` | read/write | One frame's size in the sheet, in pixels. |
| `FramesPerSecond` | `number` | `8` | read/write | How fast, on the simulation clock. |
| `Looped` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether it starts over at the end. Off stops on the last frame. |
| `Playing` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether it advances. Setting it true starts from `FirstFrame` when it had stopped at the end, and carries on from where it was when it had been paused. |
| `SheetOffset` | `Vector2` | — | read/write | Where frame 0 starts, in pixels from the sheet's top left, so one sheet can hold several animations one under another. |
